title: Learn Chinese in China
simplified_paragraphs: 去年夏天，我来到中国。现在我在中国已经学习11个月了。我很快会结束在中国的学习，下个月我就要回国了。
一开始，我觉得很难用中文和别人交流。现在我中文说得好多了，甚至可以看懂中文电视，这是因为我学习很努力，老师和同学对我的帮助也很大。现在我有许多中国朋友。一些朋友会邀请我去他们家吃饭。我对中国文化和中国人都很感兴趣。谢谢他们，我希望以后可以来中国工作。
traditional_paragraphs: 去年夏天，我來到中國。現在我在中國已經學習11個月了。我很快會結束在中國的學習，下個月我就要回國了。
一開始，我覺得很難用中文和別人交流。現在我中文說得好多了，甚至可以看懂中文電視，這是因為我學習很努力，老師和同學對我的幫助也很大。現在我有許多中國朋友。一些朋友會邀請我去他們家吃飯。我對中國文化和中國人都很感興趣。謝謝他們，我希望以後可以來中國工作。
pinyin_paragraphs: qù nián xià tiān， wǒ lái dào Zhōng guó。 xiàn zài wǒ zài Zhōng guó yǐ jīng xué xí 11 gè yuè le。 wǒ hěn kuài huì jié shù zài Zhōng guó de xué xí， xià gè yuè wǒ jiù yào huí guó le。

yī kāi shǐ， wǒ jué de hěn nán yòng Zhōng wén hé bié rén jiāo liú。 xiàn zài wǒ Zhōng wén shuō de hǎo duō le， shèn zhì kě yǐ kàn dǒng Zhōng wén diàn shì， zhè shì yīn wèi wǒ xué xí hěn nǔ lì， lǎo shī hé tóng xué duì wǒ de bāng zhù yě hěn dà。 xiàn zài wǒ yǒu xǔ duō Zhōng guó péng you。 yī xiē péng you huì yāo qǐng wǒ qù tā men jiā chī fàn。 wǒ duì Zhōng guó wén huà hé Zhōng guó rén dōu hěn gǎn xìng qù。 xiè xie tā men， wǒ xī wàng yǐ hòu kě yǐ lái Zhōng guó gōng zuò。
english_paragraphs: Last summer, I came to China. I’ve now been studying here for eleven months. My time studying in China will soon come to an end, and I’ll return to my home country next month.

At first, I found it hard to communicate with others in Chinese. Now my Chinese is much better, and I can even understand Chinese TV shows. That’s because I’ve studied hard, and my teachers and classmates have helped me a lot. I now have many Chinese friends. Some invite me to their homes for meals. I’m very interested in Chinese culture and the Chinese people. I’m grateful to them, and I hope I can come back to China to work someday.
english_full:
Last summer, I came to China. I’ve now been studying here for eleven months. My time studying in China will soon come to an end, and I’ll return to my home country next month.

At first, I found it hard to communicate with others in Chinese. Now my Chinese is much better, and I can even understand Chinese TV shows. That’s because I’ve studied hard, and my teachers and classmates have helped me a lot. I now have many Chinese friends. Some invite me to their homes for meals. I’m very interested in Chinese culture and the Chinese people. I’m grateful to them, and I hope I can come back to China to work someday.
